text: 6.08 Facility of working from a place outside the unit Person(s) / employee(s) authorized by a unit of (i) IT related EOU or (ii) STP or (iii) EHTP or (iv) BTP may work from a place outside the said unit, subject to the following conditions: (i) There must be an Authorisation from the unit specifying the duration of such authorisation. (ii) The Unit shall be responsible for carrying out the work and supervision and shall be liable for any misuse.
